exposure: Bacterial taxa (Veillonella dispar, Enterococcus, Escherichia coli, Rumincococcus)
outcome: Early childhood behavior at 4 years of age
Child Behavior Checklist (CBCL) scores (affective, anxiety, pervasive developmental, attention deficit/hyperactivity, oppositional defiant)
cohort: Nineteen children who were previously born with very low birth weight and had been hospitalized in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU).
finding: Statistically significant associations were observed between specific early life gut bacteria (Veillonella dispar, Enterococcus, Escherichia coli, and Rumincococcus) and later behavior at 4 years of age.
birth_weight: Less than 1,500 grams (Very Low Birth Weight - VLBW)
